fuelTypes.name: XP100
fuelTypes.significance: ultra-premium fuel designed for high-performance luxury cars and superbikes. Its availability at Sher Service Station is a strong indicator of the "wealth effect" in its immediate catchment (Janakpuri). Only a fraction of IOCL outlets in Delhi are authorized to sell XP100, marking this station as a "Flagship" or "A-Class" outlet.

fuelTypes.name: XP95
fuelTypes.significance: Stocking this ensures customer retention among modern car owners with mid-range cars (Hyundais, Kias, Volkswagens) which increasingly require higher octane fuel due to turbocharged engines, especially with BS-VI emission norms.

fuelTypes.name: XtraGreen Diesel
fuelTypes.significance: This additive-enhanced diesel appeals to the environmentally conscious fleet operators and new-generation diesel luxury vehicles, offering better combustion and lower noise.

fuelTypes.name: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG)
fuelTypes.significance: This is the volume driver. Given the mandatory conversion of public transport to CNG in Delhi, this facility ensures a relentless stream of auto-rickshaws and taxis. However, this high volume is also the primary source of congestion on the forecourt.

safetyCompliance.details: Issued vide letter No. F6/DFS/MS/2016/WZ/1292 on September 18, 2016. Renewed on May 3, 2019. Sh. Bhim Singh represented the station during the 2019 audit.

staffEstimate: Sh. Bhim Singh as the Sales Manager is a key operational contact point.
forecourt: The severe congestion on Pankha Road acts as a physical throttle on the station's potential throughput. The CNG high volume is the primary source of congestion on the forecourt.
